## Source and method

- https://developer.android.com/reference/android/health/connect/HealthPermissions

Every constant on Android's framework HealthPermissions reference (https://developer.android.com/reference/android/health/connect/HealthPermissions), read on 2026-10-03. Constant, manifest string, description, protection level and the availability line are copied from Google's page. The records column joins each string to the Health Connect record classes whose data-types-table row names it, and is null where no record class does (background, history, medical and symptom permissions).

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constant` | Constant on android.health.connect.HealthPermissions | string | 0 of 219 rows |
| `permission` | The manifest string | string | 0 of 219 rows |
| `description` | Google's description, verbatim | string | 0 of 219 rows |
| `protectionLevel` | Protection level as Google prints it | string | 0 of 219 rows |
| `added` | Availability line as Google prints it | string | 0 of 219 rows |
| `records` | Record classes whose data-types row names this string, semicolon-separated; null where none | null, string | 140 of 219 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/healthConnectRecords.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-health-connect-records.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-03.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
